title: Disappointing results
text: Disappointing results. These are advertised as blackout, but as you can see in the photo, there was still plenty of light coming through. I don’t know that I’d have spent $42 ($84 because I bought two packs) had I known they wouldn’t block the light. I love the curtains, but I don’t love being lied to. These are NOT blackout.

product_metadata.title: Deconovo Blackout Kitchen Curtains, 45 Inch Length, Pack of 2 - Thermal Insulated Curtains, Dots Pattern, Curtains for Dining Room (38 x 45 Inch, Baby Pink, Set of 2)
features: DESIGN and TEXTURE - Deconovo blackout curtain are made of 100 percent high quality polyester fabric. Imported, each blackout curtain panel has a foil printed wave lines with dots pattern and they are silky, soft, drapery and soft to the touch

BLACKOUT EFFECT - These room darkening curtains obstruct the sunlight from getting into any room at any time. Added to the light blocking functions, these curtain drapes provide utmost privacy as they are not see-through

ENERGY SAVING FUNCTION - Our thermal insulated curtains help in saving on energy cost as they reduce the amount of heat lost in cooler months and reflect heat in the summer. These insulating curtains are sound barrier that reduce noise from busy streets or noisy neighbors

BASIC INFORMATION - The decorative blackout curtains come in a set of 2 panels, each measuring 38Wx45L inch and no matching tie backs. With 6 stainless silver grommets per panel measuring 1.6 inch inner diameter each, these curtains are available in various colors and sizes
CARE INSTURCTIONS - For convenience, recommended hand wash. Wash below 86F. Do not bleach and do not tumble dry, warm iron. Do not use fabric softener to protect the fabric
